summary: Iteration 11 (UX + observability): validated SAP-late visibility logs, per-window boundary log, and per-window resets of globalThis flags. All 15/15 unit tests pass (14 previous + new testSapLateVisibility). Node --check clean. Static grep confirms every required string/token present in bid-engine.js at the expected locations.
critical_code_review_comments: Line 1468 sets globalThis.__firstCaptchaAt = null (falsy) while boundary reset uses 0 — both work with the `if (!globalThis.__firstCaptchaAt)` guard, so consistent falsy semantics.
10s throttle for the ⏳ waiting log is well-tuned (short enough to reassure user, long enough to avoid log spam during a 60s SAP delay = ~6 messages max per window).
Boundary log condition `untilNext > (29 * 60_000)` combined with 60s guard is a clean single-fire trigger per window.
